summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas (LPA) filed a Form 6-K with a June 17, 2026 press release announcing the sale of Parque Logistico Lima Sur (PLS) in Peru to FIBRA Prime for US$145.0 million total consideration, implying ~$8.00 per share book value. The sale generates US$85.0 million net proceeds after debt repayment. PLS generated US$10.3 million cash NOI for the LTM ended March 31, 2026. The board recommends the transaction; no advisor named. Subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions, proceeds will redeploy into Mexico. Watch for regulatory clearance and capital redeployment timeline; risk-arb focuses on closing certainty and Peru platform continuity.
